- Rule: If someone is furry then they are young. → Erin is young. (Rule 1)
- Rule: If someone is furry then they are big. → Erin is big. (Rule 3)
- Fact: Erin is furry and we have Erin is young. → Erin is round. (Rule 6: Furry, young people are round)
- Fact: Erin is big and Erin is round. → Erin is not white. (Rule 5: Big, round people are not white)

Thus the statement “Erin is white” does not follow.

ANSWER: False

We need to infer about Erin.

Erin is furry (given). From rule 1: furry -> young. So Erin is young.

From rule 3: furry -> big. So Erin is big.

Now we have Erin: furry, young, big.

We also have rule 6: Furry, young people are round. So Erin is round (since furry and young).

Now we have Erin: big, round.

Rule 5: Big, round people are not white. So Erin is not white.

Thus "Erin is white" is false.

Thus answer: False.
